campaign: Indexed graph runtime and typed model authority
doctrine: One compiled graph contract owns node order, operand slots, input bindings, output bindings, and backend execution. Host and device paths consume ordered typed bindings. Shared schema traversal replaces backend-specific traversal. Runtime metadata uses typed destinations, never reflective field strings. Artifact loading materializes only inventory selected by the compiled model contract. Each wave migrates every caller and deletes displaced maps, wrappers, reflection, fallbacks, and subset copies in the same commit.
